build_fastgen_model: build a FastGen instance from a Llama checkpoint directory with model args and device
run_generate_all: run inference on a list of tokenized prompts and return generated token sequences with stats
run_main_cli: run the Llama inference CLI with a checkpoint directory and optional interactive mode
test_get_prompts: test the get_prompts function to yield prompts in interactive or default mode
review_fastgen_generate: review the FastGen.generate_all method and its CUDA graph warmup and replay logic
